blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Silver Valley was little changed, 15 in June and 15 in September (+0.0%), and 10 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 5.2% of Maple Ridge’s 286 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Silver Valley?
Silver Valley also had 49 houses listed and 5 sold in September, against 15 condos and townhomes listed. The Silver Valley houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Silver Valley?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 15 condos and townhomes listed in Silver Valley. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Silver Valley a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Silver Valley had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Silver Valley from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 10 condos and townhomes sold in Silver Valley over those 4 months, out of 184 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
